name: Bundesliga
european_places_note: League places per competition before cup winners are added; the zones above are the display layout under the pass-down assumption.
extra_ucl_probability_note: Chance that this league earns the extra Champions League place (European Performance Spot) for next season; 0 = not modelled. Set by hand from the UEFA association ranking race.
domestic_cups_note: Set winner to a club name (as shown on the site), its football-data.org id, or "external" for a club outside this league, once the cup is decided; null = undecided (assumed to pass down).
relegation_playoff_survival_note: Bundesliga side won 14 of the 17 play-offs from 2009 to 2025. Used only for the combined relegation-risk figure; the play-off itself is not simulated.
assumptions: The DFB-Pokal winner's Europa League place is assumed to pass down the table, so 5th and 6th go to the Europa League and 7th to the Conference League play-off round.
The head-to-head criterion is the aggregate score of the two meetings (not head-to-head points), then away goals in those meetings, then away goals over the whole season.
16th place plays a two-legged relegation play-off against the 3rd-placed 2. Bundesliga team; that play-off itself is not simulated.
